trainer/31290.htm.text: Seer Skahi: Everywhere there are signs of the approaching endless winter. My heart is grieved for the future of my people! Youngster, what will you do when the end comes?

trainer/31290-noteach.htm.text: Seer Skahi: I cannot impart knowledge to someone who does not know the Secret of the Flame! Get out of my sight, you infidel!

Q00075_SagaOfTheTitan/3-01.htm.text: Seer Skahi: The spidersilk of Duda-Mara told me you would come. This won't be our only meeting.

links.text: "Tell me about the Stone of Commune."

Q00075_SagaOfTheTitan/3-05.htm.text: Seer Skahi: Warrior, you have shown the qualities of a king and passed the test by getting the Divine Stone of Wisdom! Don't forget the people you helped or the blood you spilled. Never forget that Duda-Mara's spidersilk protects you. Hand me the stone!

Q00075_SagaOfTheTitan/11-01.htm.text: Seer Skahi: Duda-Mara! You came to see me again as the spider foretold! I can't give you the Stone of Commune given me by Hestui's child, but I can tell you how to get one.

Q00075_SagaOfTheTitan/11-02.htm.text: Seer Skahi: Find the Archon of Halisha inside the Four Sepulchers at the Human Imperial Tomb. If entering is too difficult, go to the Shrine of the Loyal and fight Halisha's minions. He'll show up if you kill enough of them! Defeat him and get the Stone of Commune.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
